title: Our Town
text:
Our town has a small park. It is next to the library. Children play there after school. There is also a big market on Saturdays. People buy fruit and bread there.

Near the market, there is a hospital. My aunt works there as a nurse. The post office is across the street from the park. I go there to send letters. I like our town very much.

questions.text: What is next to the park?
Why does the narrator go to the post office?
What is the market probably like on Saturdays?
How does the narrator probably feel about the town?

vocabulary.definition: a building where people borrow books
a place where people buy food and other goods outdoors or indoors
a person who helps doctors and cares for sick people
written messages sent to other people

paragraph_translations: Kasabamızın küçük bir parkı var. Park kütüphanenin yanında. Çocuklar okuldan sonra orada oynar. Cumartesileri büyük bir pazar da kurulur. İnsanlar orada meyve ve ekmek alır.
Pazarın yakınında bir hastane var. Teyzem orada hemşire olarak çalışır. Postane parkın karşısındaki sokakta. Mektup göndermek için oraya giderim. Kasabamızı çok severim.
